title: Sony And Microsoft: We’re Keeping Tariff Refunds For Ourselves And You’ll Get Nothing
description: Following Nintendo, both Sony and Microsoft have now argued in court that they are not obligated to provide refunds to consumers who paid more for a price-hiked PlayStation or Xbox console related to US President Donald Trump's controversial tariff plan. The tariffs were deemed illegal, prompting companies to seek refunds. The companies getting those refunds are largely keeping them, though there have been some exceptions and outliers. In July, Sony said it was projecting to get $508 million back in refunds from the US government over the tariffs, and "most" of that money was owed to Sony's gaming division. Sony is facing a lawsuit that claims Sony should disperse refunds, at least in part, to consumers who paid more for a PS5. Sony's legal team, however, says Sony will keep all the money and you'll get nothing back. "Paying fair market price for voluntarily purchased consumer goods is not a legally cognizable injury in fact," the lawyers said in a memo seeking to dismiss the class-action suit, as reported by Game File. Microsoft's own legal team took a similar approach, saying in court, "There is nothing unjust about plaintiff purchasing an Xbox at an advertised price and getting exactly what [they] paid for..." Sony's argument in court added that the class-action lawsuit brought by gamers does not provide evidence that tariffs were to blame for the PS5 price hike implemented in August 2025, calling the claim "speculative and illogical." In announcing the price hike, Sony said it was raising PS5 prices in response to a "challenging economic environment," but not mentioning tariffs specifically. Sony's legal team said things like "inflation, currency fluctuations, component costs, logistics, competitive dynamics, or demand" could have also contributed to the PS5 price hike. Indeed, beyond tariffs alone, the AI-fueled demand for components and memory--the same equipment needed to make PS5 consoles--has led to shortages and increased costs for Sony and others in the market. No refunds.Sony went on to cite its own additional PS5 price hike in March 2026--following the Supreme Court deeming the tariffs illegal--as proof that the hikes are not attributable to tariffs. "If tariffs were the cause of the price increases, one would expect SIE to lower prices once the tariffs were eliminated--not raise them again. Instead, the timeline confirms that the pricing of PlayStation consoles includes a diverse and dynamic set of input costs," Sony's lawyers said. Microsoft took a similar stance, saying the class-action suit fails to provide "pricing differential attributable to tariffs..." For Sony, its refusal to provide tariff refunds to players is just the latest public relations issue the company is facing. The company also announced plans to end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028, and a lot of people dislike that decision. Not every gaming company is taking such a hard line on this topic. Panic, the company behind the Playdate gaming handheld, said it will pass its own refunds on to customers who paid more. People should get about $12 back. “It’s just not our money to keep, and it felt really good to give it back,” Panic’s Cabel Sasser told Game Developer. “That’s an easy way to know you made the right decision.” Many companies received major tariff refunds, and they are handling refunds differently. For example, Wamart and Home Depot have said they will use the cash infusion to lower prices on a variety of products, but not directly refund anyone.. “At the end of the day, a product is worth what somebody’s willing to pay for it, and there is a lot of choice in this marketplace,” Bryan Eshelman, a managing director at consulting firm AlixPartners, told CNBC. This may be true, and Sony may have no legal obligation to pass along refunds to consumers, but that doesn't mean it's sitting well with everyone. People are loudly voicing their opinions on social media, with many posting the Jeremy Irons quote from the movie Margin Call where his character says, "We are selling to willing buyers at the current fair market price." The latest gaming-related price hike came from Nintendo, which increased the price of the Switch 2 from $450 to $500 on September 1. Historically, console prices came down over time, but the world is different today.

title: Epic Games’ New Voice Chat Lets You Keep Talking To Friends While Playing Different Games
description: Epic Games has announced that it's going to make it easier than ever to hang out and talk with friends across different platforms by launching Epic Parties. This voice chat service will work across Fortnite (on all supported platforms), the Epic Games Store launcher (PC, iOS, and Android), and the Epic Games app (iOS and Android). For example, you can start a voice party from your phone or PC launcher, ring up a friend who is busy playing Fortnite on their PlayStation, and even transfer that call from your phone to your PC when you get back to your desk. This means that you can sit in on a voice call through the Epic PC Launcher while playing completely different games from your Epic library. Other benefits include a seamless approach to grouping friends together, as Epic says that if you're in a voice party with friends and everyone decides to open Fortnite, then the game will automatically drop you all into the same lobby together. This new feature is competing directly with Discord, which has been the go-to third-party app for users for several years. Epic's built-in alternative aims to let users bring their social list, voice channels, and digital avatar with them across multiple platforms and from game to game, whether you are on iOS, Android, PC, or console. Epic has also hinted that these voice and avatar systems will be integrated directly into Unreal Engine 6, and the tools will be offered to other developers in time. For now, it's currently rolling out to Fortnite, and Epic Parties will be available in Rocket League next year. According to Epic's year-in-review stats, over $1 billion was spent in the store in 2025, and it reached an all-time record of 78 million monthly active users on PC. Earlier this year, Epic spoke more about its plans to further improve its digital storefront. "Our goal is to keep building a storefront and launcher that players want to engage with and use to grow their game library, but we need to be able to connect players with the game they want to play at the time they want to play it," Kyle Billings, director of strategy and business operations at the Epic Games Store, said to GameSpot.

title: GTA 6 Limited-Edition DualSense Controllers Are On The Way, And They Look Fantastic
description: During today's State of Play broadcast, Sony announced that two limited-edition Grand Theft Auto 6-themed DualSense controllers will be released. They'll come in black or white and feature distinctive Leonida-themed graphics and coloring. Both have pastel pink icons on the buttons, with a blue-purple shift that sparkles along the bottom of the controller. You can get the controller in black or white.On the rear of the controllers, the Grand Theft Auto logo is embossed, while the grips maintain the standard PlayStation icon texture. Elsewhere, the GTA 6 logo is etched on to the touchpad, and palm-tree-like shapes are embossed on the controller grips. Both controls launch alongside GTA 6 on its release date, November 19. Surely there's no better way to experience the biggest gaming release of the decade so far? They'll set you back $85 each. At least you'll no longer have to mash the X button on your new controller, as it's been confirmed that there's a new mechanic for sprinting in GTA 6. In other GTA 6 news, you won't have to tend to Jason and Lucia's romantic relationship if you don't want to.

title: GTA 6 Fishing And Hunting Doesn’t Work Like You Think It Does
description: Rockstar Games has confirmed new details about how fishing and hunting work in GTA 6, and it's probably not what you would expect. Speaking to YouTuber TGG, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson confirmed that fishing in GTA 6 is limited to catch and release--players cannot keep any fish. Why? "It didn't fit this game," Nelson said, adding that fishing in GTA 6 is mainly for fun. Players can also complete fishing-related challenges and amass collectibles. Jason fishing in GTA 6.In Rockstar's last game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II, players could catch a great assortment of fish and then cook and eat them. That made sense given the time period of the game, that being 1899. GTA 6 is set in modern times, and main characters Jason and Lucia, like you and me, have access to numerous food options at any given time. Eating food in GTA 6 will make you gain weight, and players can use the excess calories to bulk up at the gym. As for hunting in GTA 6, Nelson said the game's hunting system is one of many ways in the game that players can make money. The hunting system is unlocked through a friend that knows Jason, but TGG theorized that this person has not been shown yet in any GTA 6 footage so far. In addition to catching fish and killing animals, players will be able to "inspect" the creatures, borrowing a system from Red Dead Redemption 2. GTA 6 also has dogs that you can pet, scold (you monster), and inspect. GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. At the State of Play event on September 3, Sony and Rockstar announced a GTA 6-themed DualSense controller.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation And Its PS1-Style World Map Arrive In April
description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation finally has a release date: April 8, 2027. Square Enix confirmed the news today during the PlayStation State of Play livestream, along with nearly 10 minutes of new footage. The release date was confirmed via a trailer highlights all eight playable characters in the main party: Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Red XIII, Yuffie, Cait Sith, Vincent, and Cid. We also see gameplay of the team in action, including team-up abilities like Vincent's Galian Beast form rushing a group of enemies with Red XIII, and Tifa and Yuffie attacking from above with a dive kick/spinning shuriken combo. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8YHP48v7vyg From there, FF7 director Naoki Hamaguchi introduced an extended look at raw gameplay, which focused on traveling the massive world map. Invoking the original game's PlayStation 1 roots, the Highwind flies over the world of Gaia, and players can pilot it wherever they wish. Once they reach a location of interest, they can choose a party from any of the eight playable characters, and then parachute down to the surface instantly. The demo then dives into a side quest in Gongaga featuring Sotetsu, a character featured in a FF7 Rebirth side quest. Yuffie, knowing Sotetsu from that side quest, has a special interaction with him, implying that some missions may play out differently depending on the characters brought to complete them. Along with the news of Final Fantasy VII Revelation's April 8 release date, the Steam page for the game dropped a few hints on what is coming after launch, with listings for story expansions featuring two key characters.

title: Jin Sakai Returns In Upcoming Ghost Of Yotei Roguelike DLC
description: Today, during the PlayStation State of Play livestream, Sucker Punch offered a look at Ghost of Yotei's upcoming roguelike mode, Most Wanted. The mode will feature four playable characters, and Yotei's Atsu, Oyuki, and Nagato will be joined by a familar face from the past: The Ghost of Tsushima, Jin Sakai, will officially return. Most Wanted, which the trailer calls a "combat survival mode," lets players choose one of the four samurai, each with their own weapons and abilities, to take them on a hunt for one of the Yotei Six. Each of the Six, if defeated, will offer a reward of coins that can then be spent to upgrade the samurai for future runs. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nlchabfwy_w A new post on the official PlayStation Blog further explores the new mode, saying that the core of the mode lies in its Perks system. "As you progress through a run, you’ll frequently select between new perks including weapon mastery, gear loadouts, summons, parries, survivability, and more," the blog says. "These are the cornerstone of crafting the perfect build and lead to some of the most exciting surprises as you find the challenge or unexpected value that comes from mixing and matching perks. This new mode marks the first time Jin Sakai returns as a playable characters since his starring role in 2020's Ghost of Tsushima. The PS Blog post says that the development team made sure to "take his Ghost of Tsushima model and keep it faithful while also applying upgrades for Ghost of Yōtei," as he can use all four of his fighting stances from Ghost of Tsushima, as well as sticky bombs, the Dance of Wrath, and his Ghost stance. Ghost of Yotei's Echoes of Sekigahara expansion, as well as the Most Wanted roguelike mode, launch October 1. Players who own the base game can purchase a Complete Edition upgrade with the extra content, while new players can purchase Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition with all content in one package.

title: Resident Evil Trailer Shows The Sequence Where Its Star Almost Died For Real
description: During the September 3 State of Play, Sony debuted a new clip from the upcoming Resident Evil movie, and it was both dark and hilarious. That should be no surprise, as comedy and horror are naturally intertwined, and the movie is written and directed by sketch comedy veteran Zach Cregger. In the clip, we see Austin Abrams' character, the medical courier Bryan, running down a street in Raccoon City as zombies throw themselves off rooftops trying to catch him. They explode on impact, with blood flying everywhere. Bryan screams as he runs down the street amidst the carnage, uttering some hilarious noises and guttural screams. Check out the new footage below. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KGlapnJFacE Cregger wanted to film this sequence practically instead of using CGI. The production team created 150-pound “body-sized blood bags” that were dropped from cranes to create the effect. One of the blood bags came close to striking Abrams, and Cregger said, “It would’ve killed him.” Bryan, according to Cregger, is an "idiot" who finds himself in a horrifying situation and is just trying to survive. The entire movie feels like “one gigantic sequence,” Cregger said, adding that things begin to “pop off” five minutes into the movie–and it only ramps up from there. “It feels like one gigantic sequence,” he says. “Things pop off about five minutes in and it basically stays like that until the end. What I love about the games is that you move from set-piece to set-piece. Every location has a unique challenge. So again, I’m borrowing from the games directly in that rhythm, where you’re just running through a gauntlet.” The Resident Evil movie releases on September 18, and it's expected to have the biggest opening ever for a Resident Evil movie.

title: PlayStation State Of Play September 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers
description: Sony's September State of Play broadcasts have wrapped up, and these were a pretty chunky look at a wide variety of games. Some of the highlights included an April 2027 release date for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, a sneak peek at the Resident Evil movie, and a stacked selection of games being developed by Japanese and Asian studios. While we didn't get to see any new trailers for upcoming PS5 games like God of War Laufey and Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, the show still had plenty of new games to show off, confirmed release dates, and more. In case you missed it, you can scroll below to check out all the trailers and announcements. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dAZRFyFQPa4 Resident Evil https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KGlapnJFacE And we're off, not with a game reveal, but with a scene from the live-action Resident Evil movie. Austin Abram's character, Bryan, has found himself in a seemingly deserted street in Raccoon City, but it's not long before infected members of the town are literally hurling themselves at him from rooftops--and yes, there's a LOT of blood. The film is out soon on September 18. Marvel's Wolverine https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vyYL1WR_nZo Ahead of its September 15 release, one more trailer for Marvel's Wolverine was revealed. The main focus here was Bolivar Trask's mutant-hunting program, which led to the creation of the infamous Sentinel robots. Ghost of Yotei https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nlchabfwy_w Up next was Ghost of Yotei, and fans looking to test their mettle--and their metal--can get ready for a new hardcore roguelite survival mode in single-player. You can play as several characters from Ghost of Yotei and Ghost of Tsushima's protagonist, Jin. It'll be available starting October 1. Jin Sakai Returns In Upcoming Ghost Of Yotei Roguelike DLC Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition: Ghosts of Sekigahara https://youtu.be/d48IWwIRg98 A brand-new story expansion that delves into Atsu's past, Ghosts of Sekigahara offers a whole new area of Ezo to explore, new enemies, and a new weapon to master. There'll also be new armor types, new cosmetics, and more to collect when the expansion launches on October 1. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMJiGh0xLhc&pp=0gcJCRoMAYcqIYzv Monster Hunter Wilds was back in the spotlight, and its upcoming expansion looks massive. Out in 2027, Ascendance adds all-new monsters to hunt, gear to acquire, and new locations to explore. Metro 2039 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKY_Ks_VG9Q The Metro games by 4A Games have always been masterclasses in crafting atmospheric dread, and it looks like Metro 2039 will continue to raise the bar for making you sweat during hostile encounters. The new gameplay on the PS5 Pro was a tense showdown between the game's protagonist and hostile forces, all set to the tune of a chirping Geiger counter. Mettro 2039 launches on February 4, 2027. Maneater 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JN7bn4eaoJc We're going to need a bigger boat! Maneater is back, and in case you missed out on the first game that allowed you to unleash your inner Jaws, you can look forward to a new sequel. Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=emymTTsBjFc One of the biggest hits of the year, Crimson Desert's next big DLC was shown off. Charting the Unknown follows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. It'll be available starting October 15. Lego PlayStation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FB8SIlnd6c That rumored Lego PlayStation set is real! Based on the iconic console, the set has over 1,900 pieces, is a 1:1 replica, and has multiple diorama scenes inside it. Final Fantasy Resonance https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IZvZYwQdXN8 There sure are a lot of games out this year with a Resonance theme in their title, aren't there? A new trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance showed off more of the HD-2D game in action, including a boss battle against Final Fantasy 7 baddie Sephiroth. I guess no single game can contain the best antagonist in video game history. A demo for Final Fantasy Resonance is also now available. Gundam: Rogue Orbit https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbTZpgq19ew Gundam doesn't have the best track record when it comes to video games, but could Gundam: Rogue Orbit change all that? The new gameplay trailer for Rogue Orbit certainly looks eye-catching, as you'll pilot a giant mech against even bigger threats in this action game. The release date was also revealed, and you can expect to step into your Gundam on March 5, 2027. And here's a closer look at the gameplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AiPllyLIvSo Hunter's Moon https://youtu.be/bKMaeHoJY2A And now for something completely new! Hunter's Moon is a first-person historical folk-horror game, coming to PS5 on October 26. Uncanyon https://youtu.be/oSLtfQ-HqLM Another interesting indie on the horizon, players will explore fantastical lands and mysterious, puzzle-filled ruins in Uncanyon. Keeper https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PilyJu1DDEo Now that it's no longer one of Xbox's first-party studios, it looks like Double Fine is bringing more of its games to PlayStation. First up is Keeper, its charming adventure starring a sentient, mobile lighthouse on a mission of discovery. It's available starting today for PS5. Rev. Noir https://youtu.be/7feaOQVG5aE It wouldn't be a State of Play without an action-packed anime-inspired game, and Rev. Noir looks like it fits that bill. This RPG from Konami follows a young boy named Asch on a journey to stop the lightfall, a catastrophe that kills all it touches. And here's a story trailer, featuring some wooden acting--which for an anime-inspired project, is pretty good! https://youtu.be/PXmX1PXvDtA Rhapsody in Scarlet https://youtu.be/DnMPeZDKiNk Another new game from Konami is Rhapsody in Scarlet, a jazzy adventure set in 1920s New York. As the young magus Ellie Myers, it's up to you to stop a threat that endangers the entire world--and we're not talking about the proliferation of horrible Jazz music. "The Mafia has magic?" might just be one of the funniest lines of 2026. It was uttered in the story trailer for Rhapsody in Scarlet, and you can check it out below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FX6kr_DoXK8 PlayStation Plus updates Mycopunk will be added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for Extra and Premium subscribers. The PlayStation Classics library is also being updated over the next couple of months, as Mega Man X Command Mission, Dino Crisis 2, and Ratchet and Clank will be added to it. More PlayStation Plus Games Revealed, Including A Day-One Release Saros: Zenith https://youtu.be/PpM1KUTh43o Looking for an extra challenge in Housemarque's Saros? The Zenith update is the next big free content update, and it adds the new Overlord Rush mode, Eclipse Layers, New Game+ mode, more progression options, new Carocosan modifiers, and new accessibility features. Gran Turismo: Spec IV https://youtu.be/qxFIHS2KhbM The Spec IV update will launch in two parts later this year, and it'll add new circuits, new cars, Family Mode, and more to the game. The first part is out in October, and the second follows in December. Until Dawn 2: Choice and Consequences https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GA0n6t-iLBw At long last, Until Dawn is getting a sequel. Until Dawn 2: Choice and Consequences features a ghost-hunting crew on the hunt for their biggest story yet, but things take a chilling turn when their chase leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding deadly secrets. Grand Theft Auto 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers are on the way https://youtu.be/rcx6I2A0TyM And they look alright! You can choose between a white or a black DualSense controller, and each one features a shimmering, iridescent finish, textured palm leaf details, and official GTA 6 branding. Preorders start September 10, and the controllers will start shipping out on November 19. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRA759MHPJs The Unknown Journey of the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is coming to an end, as Final Fantasy 7 Revelation officially launches on April 8, 2027. Square Enix also showed off more gameplay, including travel from inside Cid's airship, the Highwind, a closer look at the FITS system, and how you can switch between gameplay styles. Not enough Final Fantasy 7 Revelation for you? Then feast your eyes on the gameplay preview, which features an extended look at Yuffie's homeland of Wutai: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zv95DLDDyS8 FFVII Revelation DLC Feature Sephiroth And Vincent, Extending The Story Into 2028 Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n75P3UzZzX4 And now for the second State of Play broadcast! All about games from Japan and Asia, things kicked off with a new trailer for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3. The game will feature more than 130 characters, including non-playable characters, from whom you can learn skills to build the ultimate warrior. Fate/Extra Record https://youtu.be/nr5-XGIkbg4 I'm not going to pretend that the naming convention for the Fate series games makes any sense, but they continue to look like fun RPGs. This is a remake of the first Fates game, which originally debuted in 2010, and it includes an expanded scenario, completely overhauled character graphics, and a highly strategic, deck-building, dramatic command battle system, all on top of enhanced visuals. It's out on January 28, 2027. Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World https://youtu.be/_9nrXc0-vm8 Need a Pokemon-like game on PS5? Then check out the next entry in the Dragon Quest series, as you'll get to take control of Monster Wranglers as they embark on an adventure through a mysterious world alongside their newly acquired monsters. The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes https://youtu.be/c9V5ugavBQU The Eminence in Shadow is one of the weirder Isekai anime out there, but for the fans of this edgy show that follows a reincarnated man playing a secret mastermind in a fantasy-inspired world, you can look forward to a new game based on it. Billed as a roguelite action game, it'll be out in 2027. Rematch Season 5: Blue Lock https://youtu.be/MLDGArmX0Tw One of the best soccer games that you can play today, Rematch, is teaming up with the hit sports anime series Blue Lock. This should be one to keep an eye out for, if you're a fan of the beautiful game and anime. Where the Seeds Fall https://youtu.be/zdDJlYAVe-c You're probably going to want to avoid this game if you have a fear of heights! Where the Seeds Fall follows a soldier who goes against orders and adopts a cursed child, and together, the two descend the World Tree as they uncover the truth of the world--one leap of faith at a time. WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority https://youtu.be/fIFA-lY_f6o For some fresh horror vibes, check out the trailer for WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority. Become a Containment Agent, encounter supernatural phenomena, and try to escape the containment zone in one piece as you work to protect humanity from the threats within. Stupid Never Dies https://youtu.be/k_33MQFuVEY Stupid Never Dies--which sounds like a description of my disastrous skateboarding phase that I somehow survived--got a new trailer during State of Play. An action-RPG about the weakest zombie growing ridiculously powerful, the underdog adventure launches on October 21. SlashZero https://youtu.be/nrJuL3XSLTc SlashZero is a side-scrolling roguelike game with a roster of unique playable characters and deep buildcrafting. A time-limited demo for it is now available. Digimon: Time Stranger - A Hero's Eternal Legacy expansion https://youtu.be/8v_Mg3yAnSY Digimon: Time Stranger was one of our favorite games of last year, and we're pretty chuffed to see that more content is on the way for it. Set three years after the events of the game, A Hero's Eternal Legacy is a new expansion that launches in 2027. Crown of No Quarter https://youtu.be/OqViikdsc7Y The debut trailer for Crown of No Quarter teased a world of endless battle for warriors from across the ages. You'll need to gather your forces, sail the seas, and invade strongholds in this game. Daba: Land of Water Scar https://youtu.be/YBTN74SHUnk With the world dying of thirst--literally--it's up to the awakened Clayman to cross ruined snowfields and desolate deserts to reforge a divine soul and bring salvation to the world. The trailer didn't reveal too much, but Daba looks like a rock-solid action game from Sony's China Hero Project initiative.
